input.source:
(: User (*))
(: Order (*))
(: PairResult (*))

(: Pair
   (* (left: type)
      (right: type)
      (return: type)))

(Pair User Order PairResult)

; This bind returns a callable relation with `left` captured as User.
(: PairUser (Pair User))

(PairUser Order PairResult)

; References retain their existing node. Primitive values are boxed as
; content-interned Literal nodes on the application occurrence.
(: MixedResult (*))
(: Remaining (*))

(: Mixed
   (* (: reference type)
      (: literal str)
      (: remaining type)
      (: return type)))

(: MixedUserText (Mixed User "User"))
(MixedUserText Remaining MixedResult)

; A relation may return a callable identity. The named bind freezes that
; identity before its next application, so emitted Datalog stays static.
(: CallableFactory
   (* (: source type)
      (: return type)))

(CallableFactory User Pair)

(: ReturnedPair (CallableFactory User))
(: ReturnedResult (ReturnedPair User))
(: ReturnedDone (ReturnedResult Order))

(: selected
   (* (result: type)))

(<- (selected ?Result)
    (PairUser Order ?Result))

; A generated callable can itself be partially applied after the next
; compiler refreeze.
(: Region (*))
(: TripleResult (*))

(: Triple
   (* (left: type)
      (middle: type)
      (right: type)
      (return: type)))

(Triple User Order Region TripleResult)

(: TripleUser (Triple User))
(: TripleUserOrder (TripleUser Order))
(: TripleDone (TripleUserOrder Region))

(TripleUserOrder Region TripleResult)

; A DL7-authored emitter publishes ordinary derived rows.
(: CurryEmitter (*))

(: curry_artifact
   (* (: source type)
      (: specialization type)))

(emits CurryEmitter "specializations" curry_artifact)

(<- (curry_artifact ?Source ?Specialization)
    (curry_specialization ?Source ?Specialization))
